text:
Maya: FYI — noticed a big mismatch between the embedding counts on Nimbus Health's Feb invoice vs our metering. Invoice shows 1,225,410 embeddings billed; metering pipeline shows 1,625,803. Can eng/billing advise? customer is asking for an explanation.
Luca: which invoice number? can you drop the invoice id + pdf? need to check ledger vs metering export.
Maya: Invoice INV-2026-0092 attached (pdf link). Customer reported via support this morning. Quick numbers pasted below. Not asking for a final fix yet, just size + cause.
Jules: Customer escalated: "We're being charged for 400k extra embeddings". They're asking for provisional credit until you confirm.
Luca: ok. Priya / eng-infra — any known issues with embedding exporter around 2026-03-12 -> 2026-03-15 window? we had a rate-cap change last month.
Priya: yes — we had a truncated export bug in metering pipeline when S3 upload retried under high concurrency. Job ID: metering-export-20260315-17, commit: a1b2c3f. The export would cut off the trailing rows when multipart upload aborted. I can re-run a reprocess; expected delta ~380k–420k embeddings.
Priya: snippet of the temp query we used to generate the export:
```
SELECT customer_id, model, date_trunc('day', ts) as day, count(*) as embeddings
FROM embedding_events
WHERE customer_id = 'cust_nimbus' AND ts BETWEEN '2026-03-01' AND '2026-03-31'
GROUP BY 1,2,3;
```
Priya: plan: 1) re-run historical aggregation for cust_nimbus job metering-export-20260315-17 with forced multipart retry off, 2) produce CSV + MD5, 3) reconcile against ledger. I can run step 1 now if you approve.
Luca: estimate of credit if counts are lower? Maya asked for quick ballpark to communicate to customer.
Priya: ballpark: invoice minus metering = ~400,393 embeddings -> at current price $0.0004/embedding = $160. Roughly $150–170.
Maya: that's small but customer wants a timely answer. I'll draft a provisional credit email. @Ariana (CFO) can we provisionally credit up to $170 pending final recount? we'll reconcile final amount after reprocess.
Ariana (CFO): ok from me, provisional credit approved up to $170. Please add "provisional credit" note on the invoice and mark case as pending final recount. :white_check_mark:
metering-bot: starting reprocess job metering-reprocess-1775202000 for cust_nimbus
Priya: started. ETA ~18m.
metering-bot: metering-reprocess-1775202000 completed, delta = -402,391 embeddings. New metering count: 1,223,412.
Luca: reconciled numbers look consistent with invoice now — difference is -1,998 (rounding/finalization). Maya, adjust credit to final amount: $0 (covered by rounding) — close ticket and update customer.
Maya: emailing customer now with explanation + apology and the provisional credit revoke note (not charged). Will close once they confirm. Thanks all. :pray:
Jules: customer replied: "Thanks for quick turnaround — appreciate the clarification." Closing.
